'''Blue Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fifth member of Blue Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Five.

==History==
A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] designated Blue Five flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] in the [[Battle of Rendili]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Swarmed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]], the pilot requested aid from "[[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]," and would survive&mdash;with the support of "[[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]]"&mdash;to destroy a vulture droid ahead of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] leader.<ref name="R70" />

Another V-19 Torrent pilot, [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]], flew as Blue Five in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], where he was killed, along with most of [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|his squadron]].<ref name="SOR" />

Blue Five was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] when he flew a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCGNumb" /> He was ordered to lead the attack on the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], and drew enemy fighters away from the strike force led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="CCGBS5" /> He was promoted to Blue Leader shortly after that battle.<ref name="XWRL">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Five is the call sign given in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]]<ref name="ANHn">''[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]''</ref> and [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic adaptation]]<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who is identified as [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]] in the final film.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
